summary: Iteration 36 - Chat, WebSocket, and Calling Fixes Testing Complete. All 22 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified chat messaging, WebSocket connection, dialer contacts, AI assistant, and announcements all working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Test conversations and messages created with TEST_ prefix during tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 36 chat and calling fixes all verified: (1) WebSocket URL path changed from /ws/{user_id} to /api/ws/{user_id} - now routes correctly through K8s ingress. (2) CallContext fixed - replaced non-existent sendMessage/lastMessage/isConnected with send/addListener from WebSocketContext. (3) Calling contacts endpoint now returns all staff users (with and without extensions) - dialer shows 4 contacts. (4) Chat messages display correctly with thread filtering, read receipts, and real-time delivery via WebSocket. (5) AI Assistant chat works with Gemini. (6) Announcements load correctly (6 announcements). (7) Presence heartbeat works. (8) Conference scheduling works. (9) All existing features (dashboard, admin, events, members) still functional.

websocket_path.details: WebSocket endpoint at /api/ws/{user_id} routes correctly through K8s ingress. Connection established successfully.

chat_conversations.details: Create conversation, get conversations list, get messages, send messages - all working. Messages display with timestamps and read receipts.

chat_realtime.details: Messages sent via WebSocket appear in real-time. Conversation list updates with last message preview.

calling_contacts.details: GET /api/calling/contacts returns 4 staff users (with and without extensions). Dialer shows all callable contacts.

call_context.details: CallContext uses send/addListener from WebSocketContext correctly. No more errors from missing sendMessage/lastMessage/isConnected.

ai_assistant.details: AI Assistant chat works with Gemini. Responds to questions about the app.

announcements.details: GET /api/announcements returns 6 announcements. Create announcement works.

presence_heartbeat.details: PUT /api/presence/heartbeat works. User presence status shows correctly.

conference_scheduling.details: Create conference and list conferences both working. Meeting codes generated.

existing_features.details: Dashboard stats, events list, members list, admin users, volunteer shifts - all working.
